answer: At each jetty, buyers prepay a unique sensor-audit ID; a vine of buyer-signed sample and delivery receipts binds the report to it. Proposed validators pay only once per funded ID and label a report without receipts a fable, forfeiting its payout. A farm can share one model and borrow funds, but each added paid identity needs another outside buyer's order; self-orders just recycle its own escrow minus a burned verification charge. Reused IDs earn zero.
